# BIN DAUD Project Summary for AI Assistants

## Overview
BIN DAUD is a premium streetwear e-commerce storefront with a static frontend, an Express-style backend, and Supabase-backed persistence for orders and product metadata.

## Key entry points
- Frontend: index.html and pages/
- Backend: backend/app.js and backend/routes/simpleAdminRoutes.js
- Supabase schema: supabase/
- Main frontend logic: js/

## Core capabilities
- Browse products and collections
- Add items to cart and checkout
- Manage orders through the admin flow
- Persist orders and admin data via Supabase when configured

## Important environment variables
- SUPABASE_URL
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
- SESSION_SECRET
- CLIENT_URL
- MONGODB_URI (optional legacy fallback)

## Development notes
- Keep changes backward-compatible for the storefront experience.
- Prefer server-backed state for cart, orders, and admin flows.
- Use the Supabase SQL files in supabase/ as the source of truth for database setup.
